run_compare_sim_tests: run the compare_sim_tests script to compare failed sim test outputs against reference data
test_compare_sim_test_outputs: test the _compare_sim_test_outputs function to compare a single failed sim test file to its reference
test_print_diff: test the _print_diff function to compute and print mean absolute and relative differences between two xarray datasets
test_compare_all_failed: test the _compare_all_failed_sim_test_outputs function to iterate over all failed test files and compare each to references
review_main_entry: review the main entry point function that validates command-line arguments and delegates to the comparison logic
